approve.description: Updates spending permissions for another actor or contract.

signal.title: Approval action
signal.summary: This transaction updated token or contract spending permissions.

transfer.description: Moves assets from one actor to another.

signal.title: Value transfer
signal.summary: This transaction moved value between actors.

swap.description: Trades one asset for another through a liquidity route.

signal.title: DEX interaction
signal.summary: This transaction swapped one asset for another through a protocol route.

add_signer.description: Adds a signer or approval participant to a wallet or policy.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction changed wallet signer configuration.

remove_signer.description: Removes a signer or approval participant from a wallet or policy.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction changed wallet signer configuration.

allow_signing_key.description: Grants a signing key permission to authorize wallet activity.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction updated wallet signing permissions.

revoke_signing_key.description: Removes signing authority from a previously allowed key.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction updated wallet signing permissions.

pause.description: Temporarily disables or restricts contract activity.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction invoked an administrative control function.

unpause.description: Restores contract activity after a pause.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction invoked an administrative control function.

set_admin.description: Changes which actor controls administrative contract actions.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction invoked an administrative control function.

reset_all_circuit_breakers.description: Clears circuit-breaker protections or emergency limits.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction reset all circuit breakers, which looks like an administrative control action.

burn.description: Destroys tokens or reduces circulating supply.

signal.title: Supply change
signal.summary: This transaction reduced token supply through a burn-style function.

mint.description: Creates new tokens or increases circulating supply.

signal.title: Supply change
signal.summary: This transaction increased token supply through a mint-style function.

mint_to.description: Creates new tokens and assigns them to a recipient.

signal.title: Supply change
signal.summary: This transaction minted tokens to a target account or contract.

transfer_from.description: Moves assets using an existing approval or delegated allowance.

signal.title: Delegated transfer
signal.summary: This transaction moved value using an existing spending approval.

set_price.description: Updates a price value that other contracts or users may rely on.

signal.title: Price update
signal.summary: This transaction updated a price or rate value.

set_revoker.description: Changes which actor can revoke balances, permissions, or compliance state.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction changed revocation or compliance authority.

change_mint_budget.description: Changes how much new supply may be minted under current policy.

signal.title: Administrative action
signal.summary: This transaction changed token minting limits or budget controls.

add_to_blocked_list.description: Adds an address to a blocklist or compliance restriction list.

signal.title: Compliance control
signal.summary: This transaction added an address to a blocked or restricted list.

remove_from_blocked_list.description: Removes an address from a blocklist or compliance restriction list.

signal.title: Compliance control
signal.summary: This transaction removed an address from a blocked or restricted list.

add_liquidity.description: Deposits paired assets into a liquidity pool.

signal.title: Liquidity action
signal.summary: This transaction added assets to a liquidity pool.

remove_liquidity.description: Withdraws paired assets from a liquidity pool.

signal.title: Liquidity action
signal.summary: This transaction removed assets from a liquidity pool.

get_reserves.description: Reads the current reserve balances held by a pool.

signal.title: Read-only access
signal.summary: This transaction read pool reserve data without obviously changing state.

create_pool.description: Creates a new liquidity pool or market pair for assets.

signal.title: Pool creation
signal.summary: This transaction created a new pool or market container.

create_vault.description: Creates a new vault for pooled assets, positions, or managed funds.

signal.title: Vault creation
signal.summary: This transaction created a new vault structure.

get_total_fees.description: Reads aggregate fees collected by a contract, pool, or protocol component.

signal.title: Read-only access
signal.summary: This transaction queried fee totals without obviously changing state.

get_pool.description: Fetches pool metadata or a pool identifier for a given asset pair.

signal.title: Read-only access
signal.summary: This transaction looked up pool metadata without obviously changing state.

create_pair.description: Creates a new tradable pair or pool relationship between assets.

signal.title: Pair creation
signal.summary: This transaction created a new trading pair or pool relationship.

initialize_pool.description: Sets up a newly created pool with its initial configuration.

signal.title: Pool setup
signal.summary: This transaction initialized a pool before broader use.

create_market.description: Creates a new market structure for trading, lending, or protocol activity.

signal.title: Market creation
signal.summary: This transaction created a new market structure.

signal.title: Risk controls updated
signal.summary: This transaction reset all circuit breakers, which looks like a Blend risk-control administration action.

signal.title: Risk controls updated
signal.summary: This transaction reset all circuit breakers on the target contract, which looks like a risk-control administration action.
